ja: ＭＳ本体（別売り）に装着して、エクリプスガンダム ライジン装備を再現可能な拡張セットが登場！

ライジンストライカーパックが登場。戦闘機のようなシルエットに変形し、単独でディスプレイ可能。

●　ライジンストライカーパックを単独ディスプレイできるディスプレイベースが1台付属。

en: Introducing an expansion set that can be attached to the MS body (sold separately) to reproduce Eclipse Gundam Raijin equipment!
New equipment that can be installed on "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam" (sold separately, over-the-counter product),
Introducing the Raijin Striker Pack. It transforms into a fighter jet-like silhouette and can be displayed alone.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the MS form, this product and "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam" (sold separately in stores) are required.
● Commercialize the Striker Pack that can be attached to the "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam" as a single expansion unit.
● Includes one display base that allows you to display the Raijin Striker Pack independently.
● Newly designed water transfer decal included.
*Decal design is the same as "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam Raijin Equipment".
<Set contents> Raisin Striker pack complete set / water transfer decal / display base
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used in the assembly.
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the MS form, this product and "MG 1/100 Eclipse Gundam" (sold separately in stores) are required.
*The finished product in the photo is painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. The actual product may differ.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.

*There may be variations in plated parts due to the painting process. Thank you for your understanding.
*Depending on sales conditions, the quantity that can be purchased may change in the future.
